---
pagetitle: "`r if (nchar(params$committee_name) > 0) params$committee_name else params$committee_code`"
format:
  html:
    echo: false
    message: false
    warning: false
    toc: true
    toc-location: right
    toc-depth: 2

params:
  committee_code: "5185"
  committee_name: ""        # optional display name; auto-populated by render.R
---

```{r}
library(duckdb)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(dbplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(scales)
library(stringr)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), here("data/campaign_finance/campaign_finance.duckdb"), read_only = TRUE)

# Committee codes are a mix of numeric ("5185") and alphanumeric ("CTY51589",
# "SWGA51409") strings. A numeric-looking code passed via `-P` arrives as a
# number, which makes DuckDB cast the whole varchar column to INT32 and fail on
# the alphanumeric rows. Coerce once so the query always compares strings.
committee_code_param <- as.character(params$committee_code)

comm_meta <- tbl(con, "committees") |>
  filter(committee_code == committee_code_param) |>
  collect()

comm_stats <- tbl(con, "committee_summary") |>
  filter(committee_code == committee_code_param) |>
  collect()

by_year <- tbl(con, "committee_year") |>
  filter(committee_code == committee_code_param) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(donor_type = str_to_title(donor_type))

by_donor <- tbl(con, "committee_donor") |>
  filter(committee_code == committee_code_param) |>
  collect()

all_contributions <- tbl(con, "contributions") |>
  filter(committee_code == committee_code_param) |>
  select(date, donor_display, donor_type, clean_city, norm_state,
         contribution_amount, transaction_type) |>
  arrange(desc(date)) |>
  collect()

all_expenditures <- tbl(con, "expenditures") |>
  filter(committee_code == committee_code_param) |>
  select(date, year, expenditure_amount, transaction_type,
         recipient_display, city, state) |>
  collect()

dbDisconnect(con)

has_meta          <- nrow(comm_meta) > 0
has_contributions <- nrow(comm_stats) > 0
has_expenditures  <- nrow(all_expenditures) > 0

display_name <- if (nchar(params$committee_name) > 0) {
  params$committee_name
} else if (has_contributions) {
  comm_stats$committee_name[1]
} else if (has_meta) {
  comm_meta$committee_name[1]
} else {
  params$committee_code
}
```

# `r display_name`

```{r}
#| output: asis
# Use comm_stats for enriched metadata (party from API join); comm_meta for county
ci <- if (has_contributions) comm_stats[1, ] else NULL
mi <- if (has_meta) comm_meta[1, ] else NULL

show_field <- function(label, val) {
  if (!is.null(val) && !is.na(val) && nchar(as.character(val)) > 0)
    cat(sprintf("**%s:** %s  \n", label, val))
}

if (!is.null(ci)) {
  show_field("Candidate",    ci$candidate_name)
  show_field("Committee Type", ci$committee_type)
  show_field("Party",        ci$party)
  show_field("Office Sought", ci$office_sought)
  show_field("District",     ci$district)
  show_field("Election Year", ci$election_year)
  show_field("County",       if (!is.null(mi)) mi$county else NA)
} else if (!is.null(mi)) {
  show_field("Committee Type", mi$committee_type)
  show_field("Party",        mi$party)
  show_field("County",       mi$county)
} else {
  cat("\n*Committee not found in the Iowa IECDB registry.*\n")
}
cat(sprintf("**Committee Code:** %s  \n", params$committee_code))
```

## Summary

### Contributions Received

```{r}
if (has_contributions) {
  cs <- comm_stats[1, ]
  summary_df <- data.frame(
    Metric = c(
      "Total Raised", "Number of Transactions", "Unique Donors",
      "Average Contribution", "Earliest Contribution", "Latest Contribution"
    ),
    Value = c(
      dollar(cs$total_raised),
      comma(cs$n_transactions),
      comma(cs$n_unique_donors),
      dollar(cs$avg_contribution),
      format(as.Date(cs$first_contribution), "%B %d, %Y"),
      format(as.Date(cs$last_contribution),  "%B %d, %Y")
    )
  )
  gt(summary_df) |>
    cols_label(Metric = "", Value = "") |>
    tab_options(column_labels.hidden = TRUE)
} else {
  cat("No contribution data found for this committee.\n")
}
```

### Expenditures Made

```{r}
if (has_expenditures) {
  exp_summary_df <- data.frame(
    Metric = c("Total Spent", "Number of Expenditures"),
    Value  = c(
      dollar(sum(all_expenditures$expenditure_amount, na.rm = TRUE)),
      comma(nrow(all_expenditures))
    )
  )
  gt(exp_summary_df) |>
    cols_label(Metric = "", Value = "") |>
    tab_options(column_labels.hidden = TRUE)
} else {
  cat("No expenditure data found for this committee.\n")
}
```

### Top Donors

```{r}
if (nrow(by_donor) > 0) {
  top_n <- min(10, nrow(by_donor))
  by_donor |>
    arrange(desc(total)) |>
    slice_head(n = top_n) |>
    mutate(donor_type = str_to_title(donor_type)) |>
    select(donor_display, donor_type, city, state, total, transactions) |>
    gt() |>
    cols_label(
      donor_display = "Donor",
      donor_type    = "Type",
      city          = "City",
      state         = "State",
      total         = "Total Given",
      transactions  = "Transactions"
    ) |>
    fmt_currency(columns = total, currency = "USD") |>
    fmt_integer(columns = transactions) |>
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
} else {
  cat("No contribution data available.\n")
}
```

### Donor Type Breakdown

```{r}
if (nrow(by_donor) > 0) {
  grand_total <- sum(by_donor$total, na.rm = TRUE)

  by_type <- by_donor |>
    mutate(donor_type = str_to_title(donor_type)) |>
    group_by(donor_type) |>
    summarize(
      total        = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
      transactions = sum(transactions, na.rm = TRUE),
      donors       = n(),
      .groups      = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(total)) |>
    mutate(pct = total / grand_total)

  gt(by_type) |>
    cols_label(
      donor_type   = "Donor Type",
      total        = "Total Given",
      pct          = "Share",
      transactions = "Transactions",
      donors       = "Unique Donors"
    ) |>
    fmt_currency(columns = total, currency = "USD") |>
    fmt_percent(columns = pct, decimals = 1) |>
    fmt_integer(columns = c(transactions, donors)) |>
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
} else {
  cat("No contribution data available.\n")
}
```

## Contributions Over Time

```{r}
if (has_contributions) {
  totals_by_year <- by_year |>
    group_by(year) |>
    summarize(total = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  ggplot(totals_by_year, aes(x = year, y = total)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#2C5F8A") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = breaks_pretty()) +
    labs(title = "Contributions Received by Year", x = NULL, y = "Total Amount") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
} else {
  cat("No contribution data available.\n")
}
```

```{r}
if (has_contributions) {

  if (nrow(by_year_type) > 0) {

        fill  = "Donor Type"
```

```{r}
}
```

## Donor Geography

### Iowa vs. Outside Iowa

```{r}
if (nrow(by_donor) > 0) {
  grand_total <- sum(by_donor$total, na.rm = TRUE)

  ia_summary <- by_donor |>
    mutate(region = if_else(state == "IA", "Iowa", "Outside Iowa")) |>
    group_by(region) |>
    summarize(
      total        = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
      transactions = sum(transactions, na.rm = TRUE),
      donors       = n(),
      .groups      = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(total)) |>
    mutate(pct = total / grand_total)

  gt(ia_summary) |>
    cols_label(
      region       = "",
      total        = "Total Given",
      pct          = "Share",
      transactions = "Transactions",
      donors       = "Unique Donors"
    ) |>
    fmt_currency(columns = total, currency = "USD") |>
    fmt_percent(columns = pct, decimals = 1) |>
    fmt_integer(columns = c(transactions, donors)) |>
    tab_options(table.font.size = px(12))
} else {
  cat("No contribution data available.\n")
}
```

### Iowa Deep Dive

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

iowa_cities_agg <- by_donor |>
  filter(state == "IA", !is.na(city), nchar(city) > 0) |>
  group_by(city) |>
  summarize(
    total        = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
    transactions = sum(transactions, na.rm = TRUE),
    donors       = n(),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(city_upper = str_to_upper(str_trim(city)))

if (nrow(iowa_cities_agg) > 0) {
  ia_counties <- counties(state = "IA", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE)
  ia_places   <- places(state = "IA", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
    mutate(city_upper = str_to_upper(str_trim(NAME))) |>
    st_centroid()

  city_pts <- ia_places |>
    inner_join(iowa_cities_agg, by = "city_upper")

  if (nrow(city_pts) == 0) {
    cat("No Iowa donor cities could be matched to geographic locations.\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  # Aggregate to county level for choropleth
  county_totals <- city_pts |>
    st_join(ia_counties |> select(county = NAME)) |>
    st_drop_geometry() |>
    group_by(county) |>
    summarize(total = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  county_map <- ia_counties |>
    left_join(county_totals, by = c("NAME" = "county"))

  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = county_map, aes(fill = total), color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_sf(data = city_pts, aes(size = total), color = "#FF8C00", alpha = 0.75) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#D6E8F5", high = "#0D3A5C",
      na.value = "gray92",
      labels = dollar_format(),
      name = "County Total"
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      range = c(1, 9), labels = dollar_format(), name = "City Total"
    ) +
    labs(title = "Contributions from Iowa Donors") +
    theme_void(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
} else {
  cat("No Iowa contribution data available.\n")
}
```

```{r}
  cat(sprintf(
    "*Showing the %s most recent of %s total transactions.*\n\n",
    scales::comma(max_rows), scales::comma(n_total)
  ))
```

```{r}
if (nrow(all_contributions) > 0) {
  all_contributions |>
    slice_head(n = max_rows) |>
    mutate(donor_type = str_to_title(donor_type)) |>
    gt() |>
    cols_label(

} else {
```

## Expenditures

```{r}
if (has_expenditures) {
  exp_by_type <- all_expenditures |>
    group_by(transaction_type) |>
    summarize(
      total = sum(expenditure_amount, na.rm = TRUE),
      count = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(total))

  ggplot(exp_by_type, aes(x = reorder(transaction_type, total), y = total)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#C04A2A") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
    labs(title = "Expenditures by Transaction Type", x = NULL, y = "Total Amount") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
} else {
  cat("No expenditure data available.\n")
}
```
